title: Bit-Precise Conformance Testing of Simulink Model Checkers
abstract: arXiv:2606.24719v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: MATLAB/Simulink provides a practical modeling language and a simulation engine for the development of cyber-physical systems. To ensure the quality of the developed models, there are formal verification tools available, such as Simulink Design Verifier (SLDV) and third-party SMT-based model checkers (SmtMC). However, due to the absence of a semantics of Simulink that covers every element of models and the details of its numerical behavior, the reliability of the model checkers themselves is often doubtful, potentially analyzing models differently from the simulator. This work aims to verify the quality of the Simulink model checkers by addressing the following items. 1) Formalization of the basic block types of Simulink. It involves defining block type feature sets and the bit-precise behavior of the blocks. 2) A method for testing bit-precise conformance relations among the tools for each block type. The pass rate of our test suite

translated_title: Simulink模型检测器的位级精确一致性测试
translated_abstract: MATLAB/Simulink为信息物理系统的开发提供了实用的建模语言和仿真引擎。为确保所开发模型的质量，目前已有多种形式化验证工具可用，例如Simulink Design Verifier (SLDV)以及第三方的基于SMT的模型检测器。然而，由于缺乏覆盖Simulink模型所有元素及其数值行为细节的语义定义，模型检测器本身的可靠性常常受到质疑，可能会以与仿真器不同的方式分析模型。本工作旨在通过解决以下问题来验证Simulink模型检测器的质量：1) 对Simulink基本模块类型进行形式化，包括定义模块类型特征集以及模块的位级精确行为；2) 提出一种方法，用于针对每种模块类型测试各工具之间的位级精确一致性关系。测试套件的通过率……
tldr: 本文通过对Simulink基本模块类型进行位级精确的形式化，并提出一种一致性测试方法，来验证Simulink模型检测器与仿真器之间行为的一致性和可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a bit-precise formalization of Simulink basic block types and a conformance testing method to verify the reliability and consistency of Simulink model checkers against the simulator.
